## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Ruiz-Ortiz et al. report that their average turbulence index generally peaks after the studied crashes start and can lag slow declines. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2203.05603 · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Sanchez Garcia and Gherghe argue that their studied Ollivier-Ricci construction is an ex-post crisis descriptor rather than an indicator of tendencies toward a crisis. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2405.07134 · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Gidea-Katz and Ruiz-Ortiz et al. construct sliding-window point clouds and summarize persistent-homology features with persistence landscapes. (medium confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/1703.04385 · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits · also: https://arxiv.org/html/2203.05603
- [statement] In the historical samples examined by Sandhu et al. and Samal et al., average Ollivier-Ricci network curvature increased during crisis periods relative to normal periods. (medium confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/1505.05182 · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits · also: https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physics/articles/10.3389/fphy.2020.624373/full
- [statement] Ismail et al. choose their correlation threshold from values one day before the known Dotcom and Lehman crises, then apply it to all available dates. (low confidence) — https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/applied-mathematics-and-statistics/articles/10.3389/fams.2022.940133/full · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits
- [statement] Ismail et al. report Spearman MPS PSA 46.15 and PEA 53.85 (percentage values), with EWS=4, FA=7, FN=7 and TN=8 in their event classification. (low confidence) — https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/applied-mathematics-and-statistics/articles/10.3389/fams.2022.940133/full · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits
- [statement] Schreiber and Schmitz explain that rejection of a stationary linear surrogate null can be caused by nonlinearity or nonstationarity, and that nonlinearity alone does not establish deterministic chaos. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/chao-dyn/9909037 · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits
- [statement] Ruiz-Ortiz et al. write each point-cloud window as Z^t={z_t,...,z_(t+w-1)}, so a forward implementation must timestamp that window only after its last observation is available. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2203.05603 · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits
- [statement] Chabot, Ghysels and Jagannathan report time-varying momentum crash hazards in Victorian and CRSP-era data. (low confidence) — https://www.nber.org/system/files/working_papers/w20660/w20660.pdf · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits
- [statement] Daniel and Moskowitz report that momentum crashes occur in panic states after declines and high volatility, and coincide with market rebounds. (low confidence) — https://kentdaniel.net/papers/published/jfe_16.pdf · keywords: Financial topology and strategy-regime limits
